name: Tarrant County, Texas (United States)
description: Blue field with a white border, charged at the centre with a white ring reading TARRANT COUNTY around an outline of Texas with a star for the county, between two white stars.
history: Tarrant County is a county located in Texas with a 2020 U.S. census population of 2,110,640, making it the third-most populous county in Texas and the 15th-most populous in the United States.

features.role: ring reading TARRANT COUNTY around an outline map of Texas
